limitations: Only convex Euclidean bicentric quadrilaterals are covered. The squared-chord segment is an image profile, not an injective parametrization. Older chord-tangent literature, especially the unavailable full Hung (2024) note, remains a priority risk.

prior_scientific_review_evidence.correctness: The perpendicular-chord locus, elementary chord geometry, the known bicentric area formula, and the diagonal-product identity were previously assessed as supporting the formulas and equality cases.
prior_scientific_review_evidence.originality: The prior review credited classical construction, tangency-chord, area, and Blundon–Eddy sources and limited novelty to the combined squared-chord profile, recovery, fixed area ratio, and contact-chord defect formulas.
prior_scientific_review_evidence.value: The prior review identified the coordinate description, exact defect identities, radius recovery, and area ratio as the main mathematical value.

record_title: Tangency-chord linearization of the bicentric Poncelet family
